About this tool
What this tool can't tell you

Ranges, not designs: screening figures from published sources, not a substitute for an engineer, a utility study or a permit review.

Zoning
Read as written. Support rooms on a ground floor where "bulk data storage" is barred (Vancouver I-2, I-3, FC-2): the City to confirm; both readings shown. I-2 yards not yet read, so floor area is "up to".
Size
Real data centres sit in the lower half of the range; small downtown buildings can exceed it. Only 11 buildings worldwide publish both IT load and floor area.
Grid
No utility publishes substation headroom. Known: downtown Vancouver feeder freeze to 2032; Alberta's 1,200 MW interim limit, fully allocated. Otherwise "needs the utility's answer".
Heat
Receivers are candidates by type, not customers. Demand, current heating and willingness are unknown: heat available is not heat used.
Edmonton
Heights from the City's 3D buildings (about 95%), the rest estimated from floor area. District energy areas not yet traced; floodplain not yet checked. Lots © Altalis via Edmonton Public Schools GIS, to 1 Sep 2025, academic use.
People
Census 2021 spread evenly within each area, so estimates near boundaries. Sound is screening only, no walls or barriers. The watched edge needs a site visit.
Claims
Operator figures are labelled as claims; industry surveys as surveys.
Security
Generic equipment only; nothing that would help defeat a facility's security.
